Store in the refrigerator to calm heat sensitivity: For skin prone to sensitivity and heat, storing it in the fridge and applying it cool helps reduce flushed skin, seemingly improving the adherence of makeup and other skincare products!

avis.texte: This is a product I recommend regardless of skin type! I highly recommend it! When acne or sudden blemishes appear, it immediately soothes the skin. Even for regular use, there's no stickiness or oiliness. Wow... it's really great. Especially when applied to redness­prone skin... wow... it's legendary. Just try it for a week, and you'll think, 'Is this really my skin?' It's that amazing! It doesn't deeply hydrate to the inner layers of the skin, so you need to layer it! The pad feels like gauze, so it's not recommended for those with super sensitive skin... Put it in the fridge for 3­5 minutes before use and it's absolute bliss... It simultaneously cools and soothes like magic.

This product is a Hwahae favorite. After application, it leaves your skin feeling slightly firm and supple. There weren't any major issues, but if I had to choose one, I wouldn't recommend the pad type when your skin barrier is compromised.

avis.titre: The pads are thin and have an...
avis.texte: The pads are thin and have an adhesive texture, making them great for masking. They provide a cooling effect and are gentle enough for sensitive skin, so I recommend them. Well, there aren't any particular drawbacks. They're pretty decent overall, but I'd suggest buying them when they're on sale.

avis.titre: I'm using this as a skincare...
avis.texte: I'm using this as a skincare product for my daughter. Since she's an elementary schooler who finds it hard to do a daily mask routine, we apply these pads to her face before bed. It's great for balancing moisture and oil, so I keep buying them to ensure we don't run out. There's nothing particularly bad about it. Using the tweezers is a bit inconvenient, so I end up using my hands instead. I found that cutting the pads in half works well for applying to smaller areas.

I've been using this almost daily for about 2 months. After cleansing, I'd either swipe it across my face or leave it on like a mask. Honestly, I started using it because it was convenient, but as I continued, I noticed my skin really changing. First off, I have super sensitive skin prone to burning sensations and occasional blemishes, but after using this, the redness noticeably subsided. When I place a pad on my cheeks, I can feel the heat dissipating. Plus, the pads are so saturated with essence that one is enough to cover both face and neck. I love how it finishes without any stickiness, leaving my skin feeling fresh. My skin texture became much smoother, and I could even tell the difference in how my foundation adhered during makeup application. Although the pads are thin, they're so hydrating and cling perfectly to the face. The lid seals well too, keeping the pads moist until the very last one. Honestly, I'm more than satisfied with this quality at this price point. Now that I've finished it, I'm considering repurchasing because I miss it. I highly recommend this to anyone with sensitive skin or those who want to maintain their skincare routine without much fuss! The gauze texture was a bit disappointing for me. Still, it was great at soothing blemishes, so I can't really complain! I used the pads by placing them on areas prone to blemishes for about 3­5 minutes. This quickly calmed my skin and prevented major breakouts. On mornings when I had severe facial puffiness b

It's truly excellent for calming skin blemishes. I'm still using it and love it so much that I'll definitely keep repurchasing. It's a bit disappointing that it dries a little too quickly when drying my hair, but overall it's still good.

The generous amount and included tweezers make it easy to apply. With plenty of toner­like essence, it stays hydrating from start to finish! It's famous for a reason ­ the results are incredible... The only slight downside was that it was a bit tricky to grip the mask at times.
I was intrigued and impressed by the unique design of the pads. It really piqued my interest! It was disappointing that I found it difficult to determine whether the product absorbs well or not.

avis.titre: It has a nice cooling effect...
avis.texte: It has a nice cooling effect when it touches the skin and is easy to use I'm not sure what else to write to reach 20 characters, but the pads are a bit thin

avis.titre: I decided to buy this product...
avis.texte: I decided to buy this product after hearing rumors about its soothing effects. I knew tea tree was good for acne­prone skin. Even though I have dry skin, I often get small blemishes and suffer from severe redness, which caused me a lot of stress. After purchasing and using the Mediheal Tea Tree Trouble Pads, I noticed that the redness subsided a bit. On days when I didn't want to apply a full face mask because it sticks to my hair, I found it convenient to just place these pads on my cheeks. However, it didn't manage to alleviate the small blemishes. I guess those are still a challenging area to treat. Also, the lid doesn't screw on but lifts up, which seems to allow some leakage. The essence evaporates quickly. I recommend using it up quickly after opening rather than trying to save it.

In the morning before makeup, I leave it on for about 10­15 minutes, then apply my skincare. It's great for soothing and removing dead skin cells, making my makeup feel incredibly smooth lately. The pad itself is gentle, so even though I have super sensitive skin, it doesn't cause any tingling or redness. I'm also very satisfied using it for night care. For those who like to use exfoliating toners as a mask, it might be a bit challenging as the pads don't stretch or tear easily, and the size might not be a perfect fit. Since Mediheal has a wide range of pad lines, it's great to stock up on different ones that suit your skin. Plus, it's more cost­effective to buy refills instead of new packages each time.

It's great for calming down small blemishes and the thin sheets are easy to cut and use. I liked that there was plenty of essence inside. It was a bit inconvenient to carry around because the liquid tends to leak easily.

I've been using these pads consistently since last year, and they've made such a remarkable improvement in my skin that I've been recommending them to everyone around me. If I skip using them for even a few days, I notice blemishes appearing, which is why I keep using them religiously. These aren't effective for treating small bumps or closed comedones, so I wouldn't recommend them if that's your main skin concern.
It doesn't cause any blemishes and it's absolutely fantastic. I highly recommend it! The tea tree gel is amazing! Any downsides? None that I can think of. It's perfect for acne­prone skin!

avis.titre: I like to leave these on my...
avis.texte: I like to leave these on my face to absorb like a mask, and it's great that even when I keep them on for a long time, my face doesn't feel tingly or turn red. Maybe that's why I find myself reaching for these pads whenever my skin feels dry. Also, it's really convenient that the tweezers for picking up the pads are stored in the lid. The downside is that while the gauze texture is gentle enough to leave on without irritation, I didn't feel like it was effective as an exfoliating toner for removing excess sebum or dirt left on the skin.

avis.titre: The pads are thin and packed...
avis.texte: The pads are thin and packed with hydration. I found them especially satisfying when used straight from the refrigerator. While the tweezers on top were convenient, it's disappointing how easily they broke.

avis.titre: It quickly calms the skin and...
avis.texte: It quickly calms the skin and reduces heat sensation. The mask stays put without falling off, and it's incredibly hydrating. The clip attached to the lid is too weak to hold properly, so it keeps falling off. It's also difficult to separate individual sheets.

My blemishes completely disappeared after using this product! I highly recommend it for those with sensitive skin or acne­prone skin. I can't think of any reason not to recommend this. I love it so much that I'm definitely repurchasing. It works great if you apply it to your acne­prone areas after washing your face in the morning while drying your hair, then follow up with an exfoliating toner.

avis.titre: The pads are so thin they stay...
avis.texte: The pads are so thin they stay put even when I'm blow­drying my hair! I love that they're gentle and don't irritate my skin. Everything's great except the pad case lid. You have to press it down firmly to close it properly. If you don't, the pads will gradually dry out...

It absorbs quickly. The pad surface allows for rapid absorption, making it great to use before applying makeup. It didn't help with blemishes. The gauze surface dries out fast, so I didn't see much effect.

The blemishes on my forehead subsided in about 3 days. I'm really pleased with it! It seems to work well when used occasionally, but when I use it daily, I feel like it might be causing more issues. It's best to use it sparingly for optimal results.

It's incredibly moisturizing and excellent for soothing the skin. When I apply makeup after using this, my foundation goes on so smoothly and flawlessly. It's disappointing that over time, the cotton seems to absorb the ampoule in the container, causing the product to gradually diminish.
The soothing effect was great, and I think my blemishes have reduced too! Everything's good, but the price seems a bit steep for a student's budget...

Effectively calms the skin. Provides a decent level of hydration. The pad material is gauze­like, which is a bit disappointing. There's slight irritation when using the doctor method. It tends to fall off easily when drying hair.

I've been using this from April 24, 2018 until now, and I recommend using it as a pack rather than as a spot treatment. The pad has a gauze­like texture, which might not be ideal for those with super sensitive skin when used as a spot treatment. It comes off the skin too easily, even with just a slight smile.

For some unknown reason, I once experienced severe blemishes, but when I used this product along with a cica ampoule (not from Mediheal), they subsided. That's why I keep repurchasing this product. It's been really effective in dealing with blemishes! Those with super sensitive skin might need to be careful! The pads have a slightly rough texture, so you should apply them gently with a light touch on delicate areas like the cheeks and around the eyes. In the evening, after cleansing, I would place these trouble pads and hydrating pads on my skin like a mask for about 5­10 minutes. Once absorbed, I'd move on to the next step in my routine. I found this method really helps the product absorb better into the skin. When you're dealing with blemishes, make sure to apply this along with a cica ampoule! I can't recall the exact name of the cica ampoule right now, but I'll add it when I remember.

I have dry skin. Recently, I've been experiencing more blemishes, so I decided to try this product since it's well­known and often advertised. After using about 1.5 bottles, I feel it has some soothing effects, and it absorbs well into the skin. I had high hopes when I heard that blemishes would almost disappear within a month of use. However, it didn't live up to my expectations as the blemishes didn't subside easily, which was a bit disappointing. The effects weren't impressive enough for me to recommend it. I'm not sure if it prevented more blemishes from appearing or if it actually caused more. My cheeks felt a bit tingly and developed some redness, so I wouldn't recommend this for those with super sensitive skin.

Skin type: Extremely dry, sensitive, blemish­prone skin I've used two types of Mediheal pads ­ Watermide and Phytoenzyme ­ and loved them both! Now that the weather is getting warmer, I thought tea tree might be better for soothing, so I tried it for the first time. It's great for calming the skin, and I recommend applying it to your cheeks before makeup. The pads are a bit thin, so I wouldn't recommend them as an exfoliating toner. However, they work well as a quick mask!

This is a 100% honest review from my own purchase! I heard these toner pads were great for acne­prone skin, so I bought them right away! Since I started using these toner pads, I've noticed a significant decrease in blemishes. I still get the occasional breakout, but the frequency has definitely reduced! Before using this product, I had extremely acne­prone skin and was constantly worried about breakouts. I had a ton of acne treatments at home, but they only helped with soothing and couldn't actually prevent new blemishes... :( After cleansing, I used these pads following the direction of my skin texture, like an exfoliating toner. When my skin felt particularly heated, I'd first use these as a toner pack before applying my regular exfoliating toner. The toner pads have this unique, super thin gauze­like texture that's really interesting! They absorb well into the skin and have excellent application. I highly recommend these to anyone with acne­prone skin like mine! I can't think of any downsides to be honest. I'm completely satisfied with the product.

Before using these tea tree toner pads, I used collagen pads, but I think the tea tree pads suit me better. I have oily skin, so maybe that's why these pads work so well for me. They really calm my skin, provide great hydration, and even refine my skin texture! Honestly, every time I use them, I'm amazed at how soft and smooth my skin feels. They're especially comforting when used in summer or on days when my skin is extra oily. I can use them daily without any irritation, which is great, and they're perfect to use before applying makeup! I'll definitely be repurchasing these. Perhaps the only slightly disappointing aspect is the packaging. Sometimes it's hard to tell if the lid is properly closed, as there's no distinct click or feeling when you close it. However, the pads themselves were absolutely fine, and I was really satisfied with how they performed! Usually, I start by taking out three pads. I gently wipe my skin with each one, then leave them on my face like a mask. After a few minutes, I use the same pads to thoroughly cleanse my skin, paying extra attention to areas like my nose or any blemishes. Afterwards, I always apply a soothing serum and cream! And if you're using these in the morning, don't forget to apply sunscreen ­ it's absolutely essential!

First off, it absorbs really well. When applied to the face, it provides a great cooling effect that seems to reduce heat. It's also perfect for daily use, making it an excellent choice for a regular skincare routine. Personally, I didn't notice any significant effect on calming blemishes. Also, the pads aren't quite suitable as an exfoliating toner, so it might be better to use them solely as a mask.

avis.titre: It contains tea tree, which is...
avis.texte: It contains tea tree, which is great for blemishes, and the pads are thin and soft, so they're not irritating. They're especially effective at removing dead skin cells! There's nothing particularly disappointing about it. It works well both as a pack and as an exfoliating toner.
I absolutely love it! My blemishes have completely disappeared. It's amazing! There's honestly nothing to complain about. This mask was truly satisfying to use.

avis.titre: I use this whenever I get...
avis.texte: I use this whenever I get blemishes, and it's truly effective! Maybe that's why Mediheal is my go­to brand. I'm currently using this along with an ampoule. It seems like the perfect product for those with super sensitive skin! I wish it had a bit more hydration in it! It's not completely dry, but I can't help thinking it would be better if it was more moisturizing.

It's truly fantastic for calming blemishes. Even after wearing it for just a short while, you can feel your skin's temperature going down. It dries a bit too quickly and falls off soon, which is somewhat disappointing. Try storing it in the refrigerator before use.

avis.titre: I've been using it for over a...
avis.texte: I've been using it for over a month, and it's so hydrating that there's no tightness after washing my face None, none, none, none, none, none, none

I was impressed by its soothing effect and oil control properties. It lived up to my expectations! The gentle formula didn't cause any blemishes. I also really appreciated the eco­friendly packaging ­ it shows they're thinking about the environment. It was a bit lacking in hydration, so I had to supplement with another product for moisture. I wouldn't recommend leaving it on your face for too long! It might cause some redness if you do.

It's great for soothing the skin with minimal irritation. The absorption is really good too! I don't feel like it's making my skin better, but it's nice to use when I want to even out my skin texture.

It's a reliable product that's easy to use. With daily application, you can feel a slight but noticeable calming effect! It's not completely free of irritation when used for cleansing. Also, I wasn't particularly fond of the scent.

avis.titre: It worked wonders even for my...
avis.texte: It worked wonders even for my super sensitive skin! I used it when my blemishes were really bad, and now I only have some marks left ­ the raised spots are mostly gone! The gauze­like texture of the pads caused a bit of tingling, but aside from that, I have no complaints. Pro tip: Place the pads on both sides of your face and layer some moisturizer on top ­ it makes them even more hydrating and effective!
Oh... I haven't used it much yet, but it seems to be calming my skin down. The scent is a bit off­putting, not a fan of the fragrance. Also, it's quite difficult to separate the sheets one by one.

avis.titre: It seems to be great for quick...
avis.texte: It seems to be great for quick use when you need fast results, as blemishes disappear in a short time When I used it, there weren't really any downsides, so I definitely recommend it

It's easy to provide hydration to the skin. You can split one pad into two for multiple uses. I don't notice any soothing effect at all. The sheet itself feels quite rough, which might irritate sensitive skin. If anything, it seems to make my skin worse. I probably won't repurchase this.

I've gone through 5 bottles of this stuff! I initially bought it because of that cute pink bunny collab and the adorable gratis. But wow, this really made my blemishes disappear. My forehead used to be completely covered in angry red spots, but after using this, half of them vanished. If you're struggling with severe acne, you absolutely must try this. I swear, without this product, I'd still be dealing with a face full of blemishes. Seriously, go buy it now. I've just finished mine and need to get more! Downsides? There aren't any! I don't know about others, but for me, this is my holy grail.

I'm already on my third purchase of these pads, and I can feel my skin cooling down as soon as I apply them. They adhere so well to the skin, they're truly a life­changing product! When my skin looks a bit blotchy, using these pads seems to calm it down. There's plenty of essence, and they stick so well you can even use them while blow­drying your hair. I highly recommend them! The pads have a gauze­like texture, so those with super sensitive skin might experience some irritation.

The texture feels like mesh fabric ­ a bit rough, but seems great for exfoliating dead skin cells The rough texture can make your skin turn red if used when you're super sensitive. It leaves skin feeling a tad dry afterwards. Better suited for oily skin types Seems ideal for use as an exfoliator
